# HOLASVISION

> Full stack development and AI automation practice founded by Akinola Olayemi Ayodeji.

## Canonical summary

Akinola Olayemi Ayodeji is the founder of HOLASVISION, a full stack development and AI automation practice. HOLASVISION builds SaaS products, AI agents, workflow automation, API integrations, Chrome extensions, and production web platforms for startups, agencies, and operators — remotely worldwide.

## Services (plain language)

- Full Stack Development — end-to-end web products and SaaS interfaces with APIs and data layers
- AI Automation — connect tools and remove repetitive operational work with models and workflows
- AI Agents — production agents that take action inside products and operations with guardrails
- Workflow Automation — n8n, Zapier, and Make systems teams can maintain after handoff
- SaaS Development — multi-tenant products with billing, roles, and retention features
- API Integrations — stable connections across CRMs, payments, messaging, and internal APIs
- Chrome Extensions — Manifest V3 extensions that fit existing browser workflows
- CRM Automation — lead capture, enrichment, pipeline sync, and follow-up flows
- Cloud Deployment — production launches with monitoring and repeatable releases

## Core technologies

React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Docker, OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, LangChain, n8n, Zapier, Make, AWS, Vercel, GitHub, Firebase.
